programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this special edition of the Dog Rescuers we go to Hong Kong The RSPCA doesn't just look after the welfare of dogs here in the UK, but also collaborates with parts of Europe, Asia and Africa In Hong Kong they've been working closely with local SPCA as they try to combat their ever growing stray dog population As part of an exchange programme with the UK that has been running for over a decade, Inspector Herchy Boal has come to witness and learn about those problems first hand so the two charities can work together on future solutions

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: At Flamingoland two lambs have worrying scabs in their mouths and Dr Matt is concerned it could be infectious He tries to help a family save their much-loved pet but the future looks bleak for Rosie the hen Meanwhile another family's pet dog doesn't take too kindly to the attentions of a vet And Aztec the Harris Hawk needs a spot of surgery

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In a very special festive edition of The Dog Rescuers, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor is called to a case of a desperate dog, left home alone at Christmas With concern growing for the dog's health, can Lyndsey secure a warrant for police to enter the property in time?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Shark Gordon

programme.title: Animal Society
programme.desc: A diverse group of distantly related families and species sharing a few common traits, marine invertebrates include polyps, octopus and jellyfish

programme.title: Safari Flix
programme.desc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced rangerguide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens Not only will viewers marvel at the incredible wildlife sightings featured in the show, but so too will they be exposed to a wealth of information on the animals in particular and the African bush and pressing environmental matters in general

programme.title: 驚險大挑戰 (第35季) #8

programme.title: 新宇宙威龍

programme.desc: 威廉斯艾莉西亞在7歲的某天早晨突然驚覺,「我現在在前世玩的女性向遊戲世界裡!」。當她發現自己就是前世所嚮往的反派千金後,她決定―― 「我,要成為名留歷史的壞女人!」

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #2
programme.desc: 為了成為名留歷史的壞女人,艾莉��亞每日勤奮不懈,不僅努力追求知識,也重視在實地的親見親聞,她因而前往被魔法隔離的羅亞納村。沒想到在當地等著她的是足以左右她人生的一場相遇!

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #3
programme.desc: 天童覺原本一副懶散的樣子,卻突然開始認真。可以預測球路的他,靠著攔網得了好多分。白鳥澤有主攻手牛島跟預測天才的天童,讓烏野的情勢更加嚴峻。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #4
programme.desc: 第二局打到局末點之後,烏野跟白鳥澤開始磨人的拉鋸戰,雙方互不相讓。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #5
programme.desc: 月島終於在百般計算之後等到機會,成功攔下牛島的殺球。這時候被牛島刺激到的日向,終於開始發揮他在前線的機動性,攔網跟進攻兼顧,讓白鳥澤一時無法反應。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #6
programme.desc: 在山口、月島、西谷等人發揮實力的情況下,烏野努力跟白鳥澤糾纏著進入平局搶分。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #7
programme.desc: 烏野高中對白鳥澤學園的激戰終於來到了最後一局。此時不斷攔網牛島的月島卻發生了意外退場,在關鍵時刻失去重要球員的烏野 。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #1
programme.desc: 在幽暗月光的映照下,有艘船在海上被赤紅火焰吞噬……年幼的菲娜在雪丸的幫助下脫險,孤獨地漂流到「香格里拉」。10年後她成長為被稱作岸邊白花的美麗少女。菲娜忘不了在小時候救了自己的雪丸,於是在迎來初夜之際打算趁亂逃出這座島。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #2
programme.desc: 菲娜醒來時發現自己乘坐在漂浮於大西洋的小船中。幫助她逃離島嶼的是侍奉於霍特曼家的騎士奧托與薩爾曼,兩人接著將她帶到被霧氣圍繞的「哥布林島」。菲娜在此遇見佛蘭茲的老友幸久,幸久請她解開父親留下的石頭謎團。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #3
programme.desc: 菲娜決定代替父親踏上尚未結束的旅程,與雪丸一行人從哥布林島啟程。眾人為了做足準備,停靠自由都市巴爾巴拉爾 。菲娜找到一件商品,酷似父親遺留的石頭。但此時追兵卻上前阻撓。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #4
programme.desc: 從追兵手下脫逃的菲娜一行人前往石頭的製造地「利巴爾奥伯施泰因」。菲娜害雪丸受傷後對此感到懊悔。她向夥伴商量,希望他們能教授戰鬥方式。武士們一開始拒絕這項提議,但漸漸被她想幫雪丸的心意感化……

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #7
programme.desc: 為了修理茜的電腦,山田來到了她的公寓。一直以來因某些原因而刻意與女性保持距離的山田,不知為何無法將視線從午睡中的茜身上移開。就在他忍不住伸手想觸碰茜的頭髮時,玄關的門鈴突然響起。出現在門口的竟是茜的前男友拓馬,對方也對山田的存在感到詫異。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #8
programme.desc: 茜和公會成員們來到山田就讀高中的學園祭「東成祭」。瑛太和鴨田去了由學生們經營的女僕咖啡廳,琉奈則因明年將面對這所學校入學考的壓力而突然肚子痛,衝進洗手間。茜和山田決定先去購物,山田與女性在校園內同行的稀奇景象,引起周圍學生與教師的議論。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #9
programme.desc: 在學園祭上茜和山田坦誠地交流了心中的感受,變得比以前更加親近。雖然茜已經意識到自己對山田的感情,但仍對這位比自己年輕的高中生有所保留。在這股矛盾和不安的情緒中,FOS的公會有位女性新成員加入,而讓茜感到驚訝的是對方竟是山田的同班同學。

programme.desc: 黛拉可瑪莉崗德森布萊德誕生在姆爾納特帝國貴族世家,卻天天享受家裡蹲生活。某天,薇兒海絲出現在她面前,自稱是她的專屬女僕並告知可瑪莉已經被任命為「七紅天大將軍」。七紅天的必備條件是強大的實力,但可瑪莉是個身為吸血鬼卻喝不了血的嬌弱少女。

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #2
programme.desc: 可瑪莉突然被任命為七紅天,仍然靠運氣與虛張聲勢,漂亮地擊退了想要以下犯上的部下,初次征戰也奪下勝利,還順利與一群怪人部下開完會,也獲得了騎獸,心情非常愉悅。而部下約翰卻突然提出決鬥。在眾目睽睽之下,可瑪莉該如何在決鬥展現七紅天的威嚴?

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #3
programme.desc: 透過薇兒的策略,可瑪莉將約翰打得體無完膚。因此在部下之間掀起可瑪莉旋風,與他國的戰爭也是百戰百勝。但是在慶功宴出現了一名少女。她的名字是米莉桑德,過去與可瑪莉曾結下各種恩怨。米莉桑德突然襲擊,讓可瑪莉完全反應不過來……

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #4
programme.desc: 為了救出遭擄的薇兒,可瑪莉獨自去見米莉桑德。面對可瑪莉,米莉桑德開始講起三年前發生在學院的那起事件的真相。可瑪莉聽到米莉桑德充滿憎惡與殺意的話語,她下定決心戰鬥。三年前就讀同一間學院,卻踏上截然不同的道路的兩人,如今將再次交鋒!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #7
programme.desc: 妮可和監志因為「好像能賺錢」這個理由而開設了上傳影片的頻道「監妮可頻道」。而守仁對於妮可和監志上傳的影片品味之差感到火大,於是向班上的同學,次文化混蛋真神圭護尋求建議。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #8
programme.desc: 監志哭著拜託守仁。原因是他一下就將家裡送來的錢花光,付不出給乙木家的生活費。於是守仁將曙乃遊樂園英雄秀的打工招募傳單遞給了監志。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #9
programme.desc: 同班同學伽羅拜託妮可「復原被碎紙機碎掉的紙屑」。然而,妮可的修復魔法「魔女恢復」必須在目標物處於完整一堆的狀態才有效果,現在混合了各種不同的紙屑是無法使用的。伽羅表示,她想復原的是過世的母親寄給她的信。而將那封信丟入碎紙機的人正是她爸爸。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #10

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #1
programme.desc: 威廉斯艾莉西亞在7歲的某天早晨突然驚覺,「我現在在前世玩的女性向遊戲世界裡!」。當她發現自己就是前世所嚮往的反派千金後,她決定―― 「我,要成為名留歷史的壞女人!」

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #2
programme.desc: 為了成為名留歷史的壞女人,艾莉西亞每日勤奮不懈,不僅努力追求知識,也重視在實地的親見親聞,她因而前往被魔法隔離的羅亞納村。沒想到在當地等著她的是足以左右她人生的一場相遇!

programme.title: 海賊王 #25
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #8

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #7
programme.desc: 為了修理茜的電腦,山田來到了她的公寓。一直以來因某些原因而刻意與女性保持距離的山田,不知為何無法將視線從午睡中的茜身上移開。就在他忍不住伸手想觸碰茜的頭髮時,玄關的門鈴突然響起。出現在門口的竟是茜的前男友拓馬,對方也對山田的存在感到詫異。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #8
programme.desc: 茜和公會成員們來到山田就讀高中的學園祭「東成祭」。瑛太和鴨田去了由學生們經營的女僕咖啡廳,琉奈則因明年將面對這所學校入學考的壓力而突然肚子痛,衝進洗手間。茜和山田決定先去購物,山田與女性在校園內同行的稀奇景象,引起周圍學生與教師的議論。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #9
programme.desc: 在學園祭上茜和山田坦誠地交流了心中的感受,變得比以前更加親近。雖然茜已經意識到自己對山田的感情,但仍對這位比自己年輕的高中生有所保留。在這股矛盾和不安的情緒中,FOS的公會有位女性新成員加入,而讓茜感到驚訝的是對方竟是山田的同班同學。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #9
programme.desc: 同班同學伽羅拜託妮可「復原被碎紙機碎掉的紙屑」。然而,妮可的修復魔法「魔女恢復」必須在目標物處於完整一堆的狀態才有效果,現在混合了各種不同的紙屑是無法使用的。伽羅表示,她想復原的是過世的母親寄給她的信。而將那封信丟入碎紙機的人正是她爸爸。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #10

programme.desc: At the Satoyama Kitchen guesthouse in Hida Takayama, chef Nobuko, her cameraman husband Makoto and their cat Tama take us on a tasty journey of local cuisine served with a side of seasonal scenery

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture This episode looks at words related to Japanese sweets Explore the unique culture behind them

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #14 I want to go to Japan someday A verb with te mitai desu means want to do something that you havent done before Nihon e itte mitai desu means I want to go to Japan someday

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Hana no Kai is an elderly day care facility in Kobe that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds It makes the lives of those living out their final years in a foreign land more active and dignified

programme.title: HELLO! NHK WORLD-JAPAN
programme.desc: We introduce two brand-new English-language programs, The Factory Wonders and Backstage Japan, which will be screened regularly from April 2026

programme.title: NEWSROOM TOKYO

programme.title: Direct Talk

programme.title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo 10min
programme.desc: Introducing asari, Japans most popular clam Visit Aichi to feast your eyes on asari dishes and see how theyre cultivated using suspended cages How about diving for some giant asari?!

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: Calligraphy Day

programme.title: Reiho: Respect in Practice

programme.title: Time-lapse Japan

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 麻雀是一種中國的傳統遊戲,是香港人聚會時常玩的遊戲 傳統的麻雀由工匠親自雕刻並上色, 每項工序都不容有失 雖然這項工藝已逐漸式微, 但仍然有人為保留它作出努力, 希望傳統可以承傳下去

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 返回首都吉隆坡，敏之帶隊前往集寫字樓、購物中心、住宅於一身的「生態城」參觀，順道到超市掃貨。「睇樓」過後，楊明心癢癢，笑言要馬上回港準備置業。敏之、高Ling、凱琳皆有意進軍馬來西亞做生意，遂向當地女商人取經，了解她由零開始做到坐擁七間鞋店的成功之道。三位美女緊接細看另一住宅項目，逾二千呎的示範單位，設計實用、美觀之餘，售價亦吸引！肉骨茶是必吃美食，敏之、高Ling用豐富大餐，歡送提早離隊的凱琳。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 衍峰、淑雅前往長洲，藉着踏單車、行山體驗離島之旅。登上全島最高點北眺亭，俯瞰長洲壯麗景致！Ben Sir亦趕至湊熱鬧，帶隊參觀浪漫愛情鎖牆；吃過平安包，再豪歎隱世雞煲，香濃鍋底回味無窮。祖儀、林正峰隨歷史專家，膽粗粗開展中西區靈探團，認識本地的都市傳說。經典猛鬼之地高街、佐治五世公園，曾傳出甚麼奇幻事件？淑雅、祖儀再來宅度假，單是網美打卡的奢華浴室，已令她們樂而忘返！兩女初試減壓頌缽治療，好療癒。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 凱婷、凱文均認為，超能力是這集主題「超級英雄」必需的，汛文卻提出一個沒有超能力但獲公認是超級英雄的角色？眾谷主討論超級英雄文化的演變與核心要素，對於超級英雄是否需要遵守法律，看法不盡相同。谷主們分享最愛的超級英雄角色，以及多位超級英雄的代價與弱點，凱婷亦提到某些超級英雄初時會被別人誤解，背負沉重壓力。她們又覺得超級英雄文化對社會帶來不少好處，不僅能產生可觀的經濟效益，也有助孩子建立正確的價值觀。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 節目組讓小朋友寫兩封信，一封是給或將誕生的弟妹，另一封是自己的遺書。眾人都抱着愉快心情迎接新生命，對離世之事傷感。百日宴和喪禮，是生與死的兩樁人生大事，在籌辦過程中卻有不少相似的地方；洪永城帶孩子們作進一步認識。有男生親自體驗躺棺木、遺體化妝，感受如何？及後他為參加百日宴變妝，妝容會有甚麼不同？再探索二者的場地佈置，小朋友對選擇棺木、陪葬品各有想法；也會嘗試為百日宴製作氣球橋，及為喪禮預備棺面花。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 體肯祭將至，太晴等人參加三人四足比賽並開始練習，太晴卻因為聽見伊奈聲音一事而神不守舍。黑色新幹線戰出現，更變形成幻影新幹線戰士，這次確實傳出伊奈聲音，太晴大為震驚，適性值頓時急降。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」繼續有兒童體適能教練，指引大家做運動，這回集中訓練背部和腹部。趴在瑜伽墊上，打開雙手形成「T」或「Y」字，然後夾背兼提起手臂。轉為跪姿，垂直手臂，利用背部力量將腰沉低，同時眼望天花；改為手肘貼地，難度再提升！躺於瑜伽墊，腳屈曲，在腳部盡量不移動的情況下捲腹，使手肘碰到膝蓋。坐下，將上身與雙腳形成「V」��，做出「俄羅斯轉體」的扭動動作；再以「側平板」為腹部訓練作結。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子家裡電視機故障，不巧電器店休息一星期，令櫻家迫著過了一段沒有電視看的日子。廣明和明美來到小丸子家裡玩，廣明不小心弄穿爺爺房裡的趟門，被小丸子以此要脅，要對她唯命是從。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 經歷三年多跌勢，樓市在去年終於回穩。根據私人住宅售價指數，樓價在去年3月見底，到今年1月已累計上升約百分之5；全年私樓成交宗數亦創有記綠以來第二高，呈現「價量齊升」的走勢。樓市造好，是寒冬內的小陽春抑或長期轉向的徵兆？過去幾年樓價較高位一度下跌近三成，有業主說身家縮水，有中小企指被銀行提早收回貸款，但有上車客認為置業負擔減輕，各方利益要如何平衡？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某首飾店遭偷去耳環，店主指女竊賊手法純熟。遊台灣事主因旅伴具「靈異體質」，預訂酒店時表明不要尾房，怎料仍被安排住尾房。旅伴稱房內「不乾淨」，事主要求酒店方換房卻不果，雙方最終先後報警，所為何事？主人攜母貓急往寵物醫院求診，院方檢查後稱母貓與肚內貓嬰都難活命。主人繳款逾萬元後偕貓返家，牠其後卻順利誕下兩貓？《轟炸味蕾的廚房》記招，主持戴祖儀獲慶生「驚喜」！澳門巡遊盛事明(29)日舉行，送上活動資訊。

programme.title: 渣打優先私人理財呈獻：Grand住享樂人生粵
programme.desc: 培育下一代是家長一大難題，這集網羅有助孩童身心發展的Grand哲學。兒童馬術隊成員辛勤訓練，與愛駒同步進步，從照顧相處建立人馬默契外，還要激勵馬匹的自信？高Ling試試餵飼馬匹，一探騎馬益處。品茶學問博大精深，單是「品」字都有得解？茶文化大師傳授品茶步驟，並講述茶藝對塑造性格的正向影響。主持另向專家請教古董普洱茶知識與投資價值。從幼學懂禮儀可提升修養和社交能力，名模陳嘉容指導走路、餐桌的儀態技巧。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！《聲夢傳奇2》冠軍Jasmine任暟晴接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 方力申將登紅館開騷，主題為何取名「最佳時間」？小方的個唱舉行前，三位女主持潘靜文、莊子璇、布子殷率先各自與他合唱！何廣沛於劇集《非常檢控觀》內飾演歌手並發單曲<懲人淚，重拾逾十年前的歌手夢。雙魚座的黎展峯透過<我需要哭抒發情緒，更找來好友為其「一鏡到底」的MV執導，卻笑言下錯決定？楊千嬅完成入行三十周年個唱後，着手籌備推出廣東大碟，藉歌曲細訴近幾年的人生歷程與體會。另會倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 醬料能夠豐富菜式的味道層次，據說在中國已有兩千年歷史。喜馬拉雅山脈上的藏族人會製作生氂牛肉醬，或許正是東方人最早的醬料食用形態。河南盛產芝麻，可煉製出為食物增香的香油與芝麻醬；北京人涮羊肉時，芝麻醬是標配。以色列人則善用鷹嘴豆泥拌芝麻醬，製成當地的特色食品「胡姆斯」。日本人常以山葵磨成醬，佐吃國民食物魚生，成為和風飲食代表。香港人吃燒鵝時，總少不了一碟酸梅醬，這種以青梅醃製的醬料更是滋味關鍵。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 國際柔道錦標賽於啟德舉行，這集聚焦U21組別戰報；U21港將麥靜文、劉允樂分別摘下獎牌，並細談賽場內外的個性反差。沙田蘇浙公學致力推動舞蹈、武術，校隊分享參與得着，前港將亦憶述校園點滴。中國海帆船賽在維港啟航，香港運動員莫俊傑一人兼顧多職，完成單人航海挑戰。板網球銅級賽吸引世界級選手來港競技，助力這運動於本港的發展。青少年棍網球公開賽將上演，港隊備戰情況如何？國乒名將馬龍訪港，與年輕球手切磋交流。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 去年香港玩具出口表現強勁，不少玩具商都會在產品加入科技元素，以提升產品趣味性，情況如何？中東戰事令全球投資環境變得不明朗，制定第二季投資策略時要留意甚麼？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#11粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰拿出證據令國棟認罪，蓉蓉被假血白鴿嚇到，俊傑指是文雅所為。曉晨猜文雅中毒與俊雄有關，懷疑文雅承認恐嚇是受抗膽鹼影響。蓉蓉被狗屍體嚇到，俊傑被揭患間歇暴怒症遭罷免。高醫生自殺，曉晨認出可疑人物是Cat

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某首飾店遭偷去耳環，店主指女竊賊手法純熟。遊台灣事主因旅伴具「靈異體質」，預訂酒店時表明不要尾房，怎料仍被安排住尾房。旅伴稱房內「不乾淨」，事主要求酒店方換房卻不果，雙方最終先後報警，所為何事？主人攜母貓急往寵物醫院求診，院方檢查後稱母貓與肚內貓嬰都難活命。主人繳款逾萬元後偕貓返家，牠其後卻順利誕下兩貓？《轟炸味蕾的廚房》記招，主持戴祖儀獲慶生「驚喜」！澳門巡遊盛事明(29)日舉行，送上活動資訊。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 衍峰、淑雅前往長洲，藉着踏單車、行山體驗離島之旅。登上全島最高點北眺亭，俯瞰長洲壯麗景致！Ben Sir亦趕至湊熱鬧，帶隊參觀浪漫愛情鎖牆；吃過平安包，再豪歎隱世雞煲，香濃鍋底回味無窮。祖儀、林正峰隨歷史專家，膽粗粗開展中西區靈探團，認識本地的都市傳說。經典猛鬼之地高街、佐治五世公園，曾傳出甚麼奇幻事件？淑雅、祖儀再來宅度假，單是網美打卡的奢華浴室，已令她們樂而忘返！兩女初試減壓頌缽治療，好療癒。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 凱婷、凱文均認為，超能力是這集主題「超級英雄」必需的，汛文卻提出一個沒有超能力但獲公認是超級英雄的角色？眾谷主討論超級英雄文化的演變與核心要素，對於超級英雄是否需要遵守法律，看法不盡相同。谷主們分享最愛的超級英雄角色，以及多位超級英雄的代價與弱點，凱婷亦提到某些超級英雄初時會被別人誤解，背負沉重壓力。她們又覺得超級英雄文化對社會帶來不少好處，不僅能產生可觀的經濟效益，也有助孩子建立正確的價值觀。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 返回首都吉隆坡，敏之帶隊前往集寫字樓、購物中心、住宅於一身的「生態城」參觀，順道到超市掃貨。「睇樓」過後，楊明心癢癢，笑言要馬上回港準備置業。敏之、高Ling、凱琳皆有意進軍馬來西亞做生意，遂向當地女商人取經，了解她由零開始做到坐擁七間鞋店的成功之道。三位美女緊接細看另一住宅項目，逾二千呎的示範單位，設計實用、美觀之餘，售價亦吸引！肉骨茶是必吃美食，敏之、高Ling用豐富大餐，歡送提早離隊的凱琳。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 一男一女本地小朋友，分別與一位外籍小孩背對背坐下。大家只透過說話認識對方，對於這種交友模式，眾人感受如何？主持洪永城講出不同的地方，讓孩子們說出第一印象，原來不少小朋友都覺得日本人有禮貌。永城接着帶兩位港孩家訪俄羅斯小朋友，並一同享用俄式家常菜，吃後有甚麼感想？餐後，眾位小朋友換上俄國的節慶服飾，隨俄裔男士體驗當地傳統舞蹈。大家及後還會試玩俄國民間的孩童遊戲，這是一款拋擲木棒的競技，玩法怎樣？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 麻雀是一種中國的傳統遊戲,是香港人聚會時常玩的遊戲 傳統的麻雀由工匠親自雕刻並上色, 每項工序都不容有失 雖然這項工藝已逐漸式微, 但仍然有人為保留它作出努力, 希望傳統可以承傳下去

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 打工仔「為錢幣做奴隸」的歌詞唱出基層心聲，諺語「受人二分四」出處亦與錢幣有關！幾仙「辰砂」隨時升值變成價值不菲的古董，收藏家逐一分享私人珍藏。放高利貸人士是否必定「耳窿大」？典當大押在香港曾相當流行，財困客人為何要請當舖掌櫃吃「燉蛋」？現代「二叔公」憶述當年鬧市「趕綿羊」奇景。主持到訪懷舊主題茶餐廳，竟可找到在大型遊樂場留下的兒時回憶。今回亦了解順口又㜺鬼，還蘊藏豐富人生哲理的「念口簧」式民謠。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 獅頭紥作師傅巧製威武成品，滿足到顧客要求便感高興，當然不覺自己「獅子捉老鼠－ 大材小用」！「打乞嗤」與被掛念、被咒罵有關？說法竟源於二、三千年前！語言學者錢志安「冇事冇幹」翻看粵語長片，原來是為解構五十、六十年代經典地道用語。港人創意無限，汽水蓋也可變成開埠早年的兒時恩物，鄭寶鴻細說「荷蘭水蓋」歷史。所謂「滾水泡茶－ 又濃又香」，茗茶文化博大精深。何浩文加入主持行列，向茶莊老闆請教茶葉加工秘訣。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 主持在馬灣尋十隻貪玩野獸參與遊戲。根據經驗，特玩隊一定輸？楊潮凱認為與翟威廉同組才是真正原因！簡單只用派對紙條響哨作遊戲，當對手吹響聲時用口一咬，阻止對方得分，陳嘉桓要投訴林希靈玩得太恐怖！經典「大電視」遊戲出場，為何每條題目都是在形容翟威廉？何浩文見到甚麼而變得木無表情？出線遊戲「乒乓層層疊」，大玩隊在兩分鐘內便完成，特玩隊由威廉接最後一棒，單單是這一棒已花兩分鐘。看來潮凱的說法不幸言中。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 上陣不離父子兵的畢德利和巴尼再上路探險。今次目標是天氣和暖的拉丁美洲。第一站是墨西哥。此程活動包括乘坐熱氣球升空、和職業摔角手一較高下、觀賞一些怪娃娃、並走上挑戰極大的登山鐵道。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼繼續墨西哥之旅。完成艱苦的鐵索棧道之後，他們向西南方進發，前去馬雅文明發源地尤卡坦半島。他們去蝙蝠洞觀光，希望看到難得一見的蛇吞蝙蝠奇景，又訪問太陽劇團，向雜技藝人學習。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 雖然黛雅成功獲救，但與此同時，Bug Bug蟲卻佔領了星夢頻道衛星，並且讓衛星朝著閃亮宿方向墜落。黛雅嘗試阻止，卻被Bug Bug蟲阻撓，無法接近衛星的安全系統，星夢頻道偶像能否解救這個危機呢?!

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 是日母親節，多啦A夢見大雄只是摘了蒲公英送給媽媽，便用「體貼長槍」讓媽媽倍感受到關懷。多啦A夢患感冒，多啦美留了藥水給他，誰知有人誤把「聲音凝固劑」當作藥水吞服，結果弄得一團亂。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 開始進行新歌封面設計的14名B-PRO成員各自提出不同想法，讓翼整天盯著行程和預算煩惱。Ultras運用一直以來的專長自行創作，在公司裡得到很高評價，但好景不常，Ultras在一次直播中竟拍攝到封面草圖的檔案夾。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 主持們再次發掘上海文青小街，來到人氣美食集中地愚園路，邊嚐巨型法式葡撻，邊賞令人舒暢的油菜花田，Chill爆。在魔都尋訪正宗關東煮，以火龍果蜜桃酒沙瓦伴鍋物，味道添上清新。糖妹、婭溦光顧網紅小店，紅絲絨草莓三文治、芒果巧克力三文治，味蕾有福。必到日式甜品店，多款蛋糕、麻糬入手！特大酥皮手槍雞腿包，還需集兩位主持之力鯨吞咀嚼，份量驚人！夜深，她們還在紀錄片體驗店開餐，口腹感受滿桌「擼串」文化！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 雞髀菇含有豐富膳食纖維，肥媽以全新方法主理「手撕雞髀菇」，發揮創意煮出新穎口感滋味。她另採用冬菇、蝦仁、雞肉等食材伴以苦瓜烹調，令口味甘苦的健康食材變得平易近人。南乳的營養價值不容忽視，阿媽將傳統「南乳炸雞翼」加以改良，用油更少吃得更健康。湯水「沙參玉竹螺頭燉野鴿」用料十足，清甜可口而且具有養陰清肺功效。此外，6號於今集亦前往食品店見識被稱為「夢幻神奇菇」的繡球菌，以及了解不同品種的新鮮玉竹。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號外出搜羅枇杷花等中藥食材孝敬肥媽，還獲魚檔靚姐給予「買一送一」優惠，購入大魚和鯇魚的魚鰾。阿媽炮製一道「薑蔥砂鍋魚鰾」，並分享去除魚鰾腥味的秘訣；另奉上味道濃郁的「枇杷花水鴨��花果湯」，有助滋陰進補。二人突然上演「廚房劍擊」，究竟發生何事？阿媽及後讓6號主理「蝦乾炒蒜心」，他卻假手於「自動炒煮機」，還笑言「小學雞都識煮」！雞胸肉要炸出脆嫩口感？留意肥媽用蛋白、魚露等醃製雞胸，帶來「蜜汁雞球」。

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿接下挑戰任務，要成為「仁濟」慈善直播騷監製，夢想有全女班幕後班底，但現實總是充滿不可能！一眾藝員「轉職」幕後，事前對創製不同崗位的認識有幾深？趁有其他慈善騷綵排，導演賴慰玲、助導程浩駿、關楓馨深入一廠控制室偷師，及後卻認定任務不可能！至於負責撰稿的戴祖儀、李芷晴、梁超怡則到機構轄下設施做資料搜集，沒有紙筆記下重點的她們，感覺更像藝人探訪。眾人於賣橋會議意見多多，卻換來節目策劃高層皺着眉離開？

programme.title: 不可能任務粵
programme.desc: 賣橋會議後，監製諾懿對團隊「黑面」，唯盼大家可切實構思好節目方向。或許對創製崗位未太熟識，眾人先上「雞精班」認清撰稿、助導的日常工作與要求。向仁濟一方匯報構思，機構代表聽後竟然講抱歉？這句開場白令諾懿大感壓力，幸好最終獲讚！「導演」慰玲、「助導」楓馨、「撰稿」芷晴出發進行外景拍攝，到達場地後，楓馨卻被攝影師怒視，究竟她犯了甚麼「死罪」？拍外景常有突發事，場地代表阻止拍攝，慰玲如何引領團隊解決問題？

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵
programme.desc: 怡保「芯」度行啟程，黎諾懿相約首集嘉賓李佳芯遊二奶巷掃街，還找到數年前與店家的合照？百年藥材店轉型茶室，兩人獲老闆招待，細味茶文化。木工廠成小朋友樂園，達人手製木造玩具送給大家！佳芯重拾童趣，也意外顯露「老靈魂」？坐小船穿過山洞，迎來世外桃源般的鏡湖秘景，用心感受大自然的純粹。佳芯歎白咖啡順道學拉茶啡，諾懿卻彈到二樓「食花生」；咖央多士一啖一牛油，好邪惡！接着深入鄉郊的榴槤樹屋，享受片刻恬靜時光。

programme.title: 隨懿深度行粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓劉穎鏇初次踏足馬來西亞，想瘋狂歎美食，卻被帶到羅京森林……尋找「世界最大之花」大王花，諾懿背起穎鏇涉水渡河，說好的悠閒之旅呢？金馬崙高原是避暑勝地，穎鏇體驗餵羊與趕羊，卻遭無視？諾懿更被草泥馬口水突襲！走進夢幻花海打卡，再DIY微型生態盆栽，好療癒！豪華營地內的全透明「水晶房」，觀星住宿之選。嚐過士多啤梨雞飯後，二人行逛夜市感受地道風情。返回營區繼續食，好友圍爐自製番薯糖水，回顧旅程深刻點滴。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 不論學做甜品還是學習演戲，在名師指導下當然事半功倍。何廣沛專誠來向阿古(古嘉俊)拜師，透過學做「檸檬開心果朱古力粒」，領略甜品製作竅門。檸檬汁的酸性會與鮮奶產生化學作用，本來不宜作為朱古力材料，到底阿古有何方法將檸檬芳香融入朱古力？自家製開心果醬不但口味獨特，翠緣顏色還令何廣沛聯想到日式芥辣。原來阿古亦曾以日式芥辣製作甜品，他在節目中分享有趣經驗。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴因適性值不足未能參戰，加上良太和茜的冷言冷語，終於忍不住一走了之。太晴躲進元宇宙之中，詎料伊奈突然出現，更邀請太晴與她一起摧毀超鐵機。太晴察覺不妥並拒絕，其後伊奈向超鐵機正式宣戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 揚琴是中國一種傳統擊弦樂器，演奏時以琴竹敲擊琴弦發聲，音色清脆悅耳。本集「My Little Show」，一位女生帶來揚琴獨奏，值得細心聆聽。另有六位小女孩手持豬仔錢罌登場，送上充滿童趣的芭蕾舞表演。此外，主持姐姐、女結他導師合唱<星星的加冕和<家有小熊兩首「童話與夢想之歌」。她們在交流中談及兒時的勇敢行為與夢想，瀅仴姐姐分享自己成功實現成為演員的心願。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 著名設計師黑鷲久美子舉辦時裝表演，惟屬於重頭戲的公主蛋頭冠卻離奇消失，屁屁偵探應邀去協助調查，卻發現警官數量甚少，原來久美子拒絕報警，屁屁偵探從久美子與模特兒的對話發現案情不單純。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在電視上看到有車輪的行李箱，覺得很新奇，爺爺向英叔借了回來，兩人籌備去旅行。姐姐遺失了和良子同學一起造的扣針，遍尋不獲，野口教小丸子把失物倒轉來唸，便有可能把失物尋回。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 危機現場粵
programme.desc: 本片選取近年來國內最具代表性的安全事故和自然災害，作科學分析，重現處置過程，展現當下中國應急救援專業能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事發原因和調查過程，解讀事故隱患。同時，展示人類的勇氣、智慧與無畏。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 近年香港的士行業迎來「新血」，運輸署資料顯示，截至2025年10月，40歲或以下持牌司機增加至182萬人，較2019年顯著上升五成四。這群年輕司機，大多追求彈性工時，以及多勞多得的收入結構。當中部分人組成車隊，透過社交媒體，積極開拓新市場；也有人成為「的士打理人」，承擔十多部的士的管理責任。他們會為行業帶來甚麼新氣象？在過程中，又會面對甚麼困難？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港何濟公止痛退熱散呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 「黑白榮耀換位賽」，翻出第二章。上一集，「上弦黑隊」全員成功守住寶座，本集五回對決中，「下弦白隊」可會有人能夠「反Cup」？而掉進「危險區」的五位選手，究竟哪兩人即將告別「中4」舞台？

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 遊戲節目《唱錢》引來網絡熱話，主持兼音樂總監Eric Kwok更為相關評分系統付出極大心力！太太葉佩雯於「你問我答」拍片提問，想知Eric突然不怕蟑螂的原因。說起太太，《唱錢》另一主持森美當年瞞婚，為何近年不介意多談家庭事？身邊朋友常聽森美提到會退休，究竟幾時才退？另外，對於被指在作曲方面江郎才盡，Eric坦言對作曲的興趣有所減退，其中一個原因是多了XiX經理人的身分，還自揭並非主動提出要任此職！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 行仔與鼎爺到訪星廚主理的私房菜館，品嚐以法式吊湯方式烹調的羊肚菌清雞湯、內藏「佛跳牆」的炸子雞，極富心思。居港瑞士廚師帶暉哥享用正宗瑞士菜，包括傳統芝士火鍋、蘇黎世式牛仔肉等佳餚，並細說瑞士飲食文化。行仔再與伍倩彤到大澳「掃街」，遍嚐即炸沙翁、蝦醬豬肉捲餅、炭燒黃花魚春及瀨尿蝦乾，別具風味。尖沙咀一間24小時營業的食店，復刻昔日車仔檔的沙嗲風味，燒鴨絲沙嗲米通粉、沙嗲小食拼盤，皆是宵夜好選擇。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
叠影狙擊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 忠仔突然身亡，晟杰讓曉晨向Green World成員套話，Tina向曉晨承認他們在工地的水泥袋裡發現很多錢，懷疑新領域集團走私黑錢。忠仔因缺錢，半夜到工地偷錢，極可能因此遇害。文諾看到忠仔的新聞，安排霆釗進行下一步行動。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 親近動物有不少方法，這趟旅程會多角度展示。從小已怕動物的慰玲猜拳輸了要餵羊駝，竟被牠嚇至跌倒，還驚到喊。朱仔首次騎馬後，形容似「坐過山車」，一邊騎馬，一邊亦可欣賞戶外駿域谷的美景。主持們還乘坐馬車遊覽，振朗卻差點被拋出車外。深入遠離悉尼市區的獵人谷，先到百年歷史的酒窖品酒，加上朱古力Pairing就更出眾？其後，三位好友安躺草地看日落，細談「浪漫的定義」。而慰玲心目中的浪漫，竟只是一句話這般簡單？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 繼續暢遊獵人谷，主持們在戶外學造朱古力；朱仔嘗試追女仔慘「食檸檬」，只好向男拍檔出手？玩電動平衡車時，振朗被慰玲「嫌廢」。在邦迪海灘開心踏浪，怎料眾人最終濕身收場！清晨五時，大家划獨木舟出海看日出。「鹹蛋黃」初升之際，畫面卻令幕後人員崩潰，究竟發生何事？振朗及後更模仿蔡思貝發聲控訴？在酒吧喝着雞尾酒聚話，節目組準備了情感問題，讓三人來一趟深情對話。當要向身旁好友說出心底話，振朗、慰玲更雙雙落淚……

programme.desc: 不論學做甜品還是學習演戲，在名師指導下當然事半功倍。何廣沛專誠來向阿古(古嘉俊)拜師，透過學做「檸檬開心果朱古力粒」，領略甜品製作竅門。檸檬汁的酸性會與鮮奶產生化學作用，本來不宜作為朱古力材料，到底阿古有何方法將檸檬芳香融入朱古力？自家製開心果醬不但口味獨特，翠緣顏色還令何廣沛聯想到日式芥辣。原來阿古亦曾以日式芥辣製作甜品，他在節目中分享有趣經驗。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 轉轉口味，糖妹、婭溦這集來到上海的韓國街，化身「韓妹」遍尋韓式小吃。快餐車直送芝士香腸熱狗、奶油年糕湯。未夠滋味？幫襯出爐熱辣辣核桃餅與咖啡豆餅。炭燒烤肉風味大餐開動！厚切豬五花棒棒糖、豬豬星球拼盤，還不及火豚星三拼飯邪惡！大口吞下韓國的味道，難怪婭溦要點喝清腸排毒果汁。主持們換上漢服，置身格調優雅的文化茶館，在城市中的世外桃源歇一歇息。入夜，全力衝刺全蟹宴私房菜，婭溦帶來獨門拌蟹麵吃法！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 雞髀菇含有豐富膳食纖維，肥媽以全新方法主理「手撕雞髀菇」，發揮創意煮出新穎口感滋味。她另採用冬菇、蝦仁、雞肉等食材伴以苦瓜烹調，令口味甘苦的健康食材變得平易近人。南乳的營養價值不容忽視，阿媽將傳統「南乳炸雞翼」加以改良，用油更少吃得更健康。湯水「沙參玉竹螺頭燉野鴿」用料十足，清甜可口而且具有養陰清肺功效。此外，6號於今集亦前往食品店見識被稱為「夢幻神奇菇」的繡球菌，以及了解不同品種的新鮮玉竹。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 6號外出搜羅枇杷花等中藥食材孝敬肥媽，還獲魚檔靚姐給予「買一送一」優惠，購入大魚和鯇魚的魚鰾。阿媽炮製一道「薑蔥砂鍋魚鰾」，並分享去除魚鰾腥味的秘訣；另奉上味道濃郁的「枇杷花水鴨紫花果湯」，有助滋陰進補。二人突然上演「廚房劍擊」，究竟發生何事？阿媽及後讓6號主理「蝦乾炒蒜心」，他卻假手於「自動炒煮機」，還笑言「小學雞都識煮」！雞胸肉要炸出脆嫩口感？留意肥媽用蛋白、魚露等醃製雞胸，帶來「蜜汁雞球」。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 上陣不離父子兵的畢德利和巴尼再上路探險。今次目標是天氣和暖的拉丁美洲。第一站是墨西哥。此程活動包括乘坐熱氣球升空、和職業摔角手一較高下、觀賞一些怪娃娃、並走上挑戰極大的登山鐵道。

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼繼續墨西哥之旅。完成艱苦的鐵索棧道之後，他們向西南方進發，前去馬雅文明發源地尤卡坦半島。他們去蝙蝠洞觀光，希望看到難得一見的蛇吞蝙蝠奇景，又訪問太陽劇團，向雜技藝人學習。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#64粵
programme.desc: 朋指悅教壞女兒，夫妻進入冷戰狀態。悅更為此搬到隔壁與情同床，朋卻愛理不理。悅氣憤難消，竟要搬到賓館居住，但悅所住的賓館位於龍蛇混雜之地，衛生環境差勁，令不懂世事的悅苦不堪言，翌日悅發覺賓館已改頭換面。

programme.title: 尚食#4粵普
programme.desc: 殷紫萍想用繩子勒死子衿，幸子衿反應快沒讓她得逞；子衿在錦衣衛等眾人面前與老媽子對質，讓錦衣衛倖然而去；紫萍對子衿說出身世讓門外的人聽去，且報告予孟紫澐；朱瞻基有輕微中毒反應，他對下毒的人心裡有數。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 廚餘都可成為美食，鼎爺與阿譚到魚蛋店，見識炸魚皮的整個工序。雲吞皮能夠煲糖水，也可幻化成「片兒麵」這種懷舊小食。鼎爺明明要做「火雞片兒麵」，為何不見有火雞？這碗片兒麵的精髓是雞湯，而調製「皮水」的糖、醋、水的比例則要拿得準繩。鼎爺接着為田雞腿去骨，再加入不少料頭及白玉苦瓜燜煮，出爐菜式「啖啖肉」！還有甜品水果大菜糕，選用水果並非喜愛即可，也要顧及味道與顏色。此外，要加強降火效用，可再加入甚麼材料？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 家族性腺瘤性瘜肉症(FAP)是一種基因突變引起的遺傳病，大腸內會長出成百上千顆腺瘤性瘜肉，外科專科醫生指出定會演變成腸癌，亦會影響其他器官？醫生建議患者接受預防性全大腸切除手術，可望徹底解決問題。烹飪節目《轟炸味蕾的廚房》主持區永權、戴祖儀到來，暢談拍攝點滴。兩人也向大王形容吃過的美食，零入廚經驗的祖儀更因節目想嘗試下廚？「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「番茄煮魚」，用罐頭番茄可能比新鮮番茄更好？

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 在汕頭，似乎甚麼食材都可用來製作粿品，祖藍學習造粿，脫模的臨門一腳卻有甩漏！他亦即場試吃蒸粿與煎粿的分別。潮汕牛肉火鍋可謂火鍋界的「天花板」，不同刁鑽部位也可嚐到；店家附上淥煮時間參考，祖藍偏偏不愛跟。他還「火雞姐」上身，試打牛丸，累透了，唯有多吃一點補充體力，牛肉確實夠新鮮！汕頭甜湯即香港的糖水，傳統上有何款式可選？交由老闆娘親自推薦。作為「潮」店當然亦有創新選擇，鹹蛋與菠菜也跟甜品扯上關係？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#16粵
programme.desc: 德正心中有愧，勸竇彰考慮清楚是否轉讓三成股權，及後又指責曉盈設局陷害使百喜昇擁有鼎福和五成半股權。司徒嵐認為力奇愛上喜詩；但喜詩喜歡竇彰，菲兒則喜歡力奇，結果變成四角戀。佩珊找舊上司有意重投保險行業，舊上司認為她已毁容不易推銷。秀瓊與威龍一同到佩珊家吃飯，灌醉威龍後扶他上床；之後秀瓊與麗娟將威龍和佩珊的床照給曉盈看……德正在機場餐廳與美娜發生爭執，秀瓊質問下得悉竇彰和兆明跟百喜昇簽約注資……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: IDOLiSH7舉行巡迴演唱會，氣氛非常熱烈。九条要天離開TRIGGER單飛，天說服對方讓自己留下。千找上曙光電視台製作局長，要求他站在自己一方。TRIGGER尋找演唱會場地不果，決定成為街頭藝人，無懼可能的嘻笑怒罵。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 正值馬年，自然教育機構聯合創辦人帶來六種含有「馬」字的生物圖片，考考主持對大自然的認識。馬蹄蟹、馬陸都是節肢動物，分別被指似蟹和蜈蚣，但其實大有不同！馬蹄蟹為何被稱為「活化石」？馬陸在自然界更擔任「清道夫」角色。成年馬蜂會吃花蜜，幼蟲卻有另一款食物！屬魚類的海馬，養育子女的重任原來會交予雄性，相當得意。至於馬藍和印度馬兜鈴同是植物，前者可製成染料或藥材，後者受法例保護不能採摘，只因要保護某種蝴蝶？

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 多啦A夢和大雄因為誤會發生爭執，大雄一氣之下在前者的照片塗鴉，卻發現對方真的變成了大花臉。多啦A夢召集大家玩「真實環遊日本特快車大富翁」，可以在玩大富翁的同時，體驗在日本各地旅行。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 樓市交投加快，深井有海景單位，呎價較去年升近兩成，哪些因素支撐樓價？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2774粵
programme.desc: Rebecca與張龍分手後，若水等人察覺她有不妥，住所更淪為「恐怖屋」。原來她身心俱疲，不願處理工作以外之事，眾人於是代為分擔。另一方面，Rebecca接到不少帳單，卻懶於理會，而若水等人亦厭煩繁瑣事項。Sam等人舉辦聚會，互相幫忙處理生活瑣事，若水等遂仿傚舉辦「行政之夜」，成效顯著。為免Rebecca睹物思人，眾人落力清理各種跟張龍有關的物品，並代為處理相關麻煩事務，Rebecca卻有事相瞞……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#1粵PG
programme.desc: 某天台遊樂場發生一宗悲劇，八歲小童胡宇澤墮樓身亡，而年僅十四歲、殿堂級大狀高淑樺之子高成彬被控謀殺，案件轟動全城，主審正是言惠知法官。高等法院常任法官陳官舉行榮休晚會，準備宣佈由惠知接任，卻因惠知的負面傳聞而需要暫緩。成彬由緘默改為選擇答辯，淑樺申請延後審訊尋找更多證據，惠知批准；惠知這決定，被其在律政司任職的丈夫邱光正認為過於冒險。正當一切塵埃落定，惠知準備晉升的宣誓之際，卻接到一個震撼的消息！

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#18粵普PG
programme.desc: 景翊搜出木質官印，揭穿江到海偽造官印，高羅遷被控以毒藥脅迫官員。皇帝命瑾瑜赴交州查看情況，柳世江返交州後失蹤，屍體在竹林被尋獲，並身插竹筍，周遭毒蟲拼出讖言；仵作初判為意外，楚楚主張解剖卻遭韓績阻撓。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 在內蒙古，民眾會以「烤羊腿」招待尊貴客人。為節目「打頭陣」的李家鋌師傅同樣以羊腿入饌，讓觀眾感受第一道轟炸味蕾的菜式。家鋌師傅以電飯煲炮製「羊腩叉燒」，香甜惹味。其間，主持戴祖儀「好奇」提出不少疑問，卻變相自揭下廚近乎零經驗……雲南西雙版納的雨林盛產芭蕉芯，主持準備了實物展示其「拉絲」特色。周世韜師傅接力登場，參考當地人用芭蕉葉包裹肉類烹調的手法，呈獻「梅菜粽是燜豬腩肉」，腩肉軟腍入味，令人垂涎！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#34粵
programme.desc: 天上一顆殞石墜落，群臣驚惶失措，少龍使計直指是大吉之兆，不韋奸計不得逞。趙國派李牧帶兵來犯，嬴政無奈讓王翦、嫪毐及少龍比試，勝者得帥印。嫪毐苦練劍術，朱姬不敢告知有身孕。比試日，嫪毐發現全身乏力，知道朱姬暗中下藥後勃然大怒。少龍心知王翦馬上功夫厲害，遂以現代武術將他打敗，不韋氣結。少龍向嬴政舉薦王翦做副將，王翦感激。琴清得悉少龍奪得帥印，傷心失望，又憶起洞房夜丈夫被召入伍及一去不返，心有決定。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#64粵
programme.desc: 朋指悅教壞女兒，夫妻進入冷戰狀態。悅更為此搬到隔壁與情同床，朋卻愛理不理。悅氣憤難消，竟要搬到賓館居住，但悅所住的賓館位於龍蛇混雜之地，衛生環境差勁，令不懂世事的悅苦不堪言，翌日悅發覺賓館已改頭換面。

programme.title: 尚食#4粵普
programme.desc: 殷紫萍想用繩子勒死子衿，幸子衿反應快沒讓她得逞；子衿在錦衣衛等眾人面前與老媽子對質，讓錦衣衛倖然而去；紫萍對子衿說出身世讓門外的人聽去，且報告予孟紫澐；朱瞻基有輕微中毒反應，他對下毒的人心裡有數。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 萌馬吼吼S1
programme.desc: 主人公吼吼，是一隻可愛的奶油獨角獸，他生活在甜蜜鎮上，這裡的居民都是各種甜品，有著各自的職業。作為一名快樂的打工人，吼吼每天都在小鎮的不同地方打工，當髮型師助理時，用自己的奶油為甜品們打造時下最流行的髮型，尤其是杯子蛋糕，對他的設計總是讚不絕口；吼吼還做過神奇的天氣安排員，尤其是想要吃糖的日子，更是少不了吼吼的精心安排，來一場美味的糖果雨，讓甜蜜在整個小鎮裡傳遞且讓吼吼的生活永遠不缺好玩的事。

programme.title: 萌馬吼吼S1
programme.desc: 主人公吼吼，是一隻可愛的奶油獨角獸，他生活在甜蜜鎮上，這裡的居民都是各種甜品，有著各自的職業。作為一名快樂的打工人，吼吼每天都在小鎮的不同地方打工，當髮型師助理時，用自己的奶油為甜品們打造時下最流行的髮型，尤其是杯子蛋糕，對他的設計總是讚不絕口；吼吼還做過神奇的天氣安排員，尤其是想要吃糖的日子，更是少不了吼吼的精心安排，來一場美味的糖果雨，讓甜蜜在整個小鎮裡傳遞且讓吼吼的生活永遠不缺好玩的事。

programme.title: 檢索愛情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X張基龍大談姐弟戀年下男狂撩職場女強人】聚焦於三位35歲女性——裴朵美、車賢和宋佳景，她們在職場和感情中勇敢追夢。這三位獨立的女性，專注於自己的事業，成為職場上的佼佼者。然而在她們堅強的外表下，深藏著對愛情的渴望。儘管在追求夢想的道路上充滿坎坷，她們依然堅信自己的抉擇。在她們身後都有一位，用自己的方式默默守護的真命天子，以現實的筆觸描繪了這三個女性在職場上的競爭和情感中的糾結，將粉紅泡泡與現實的辛酸完美結合。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.desc: Po finds a teddy bear in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­‐Laa and Po excitedly show the teddy to the Tiddlytubbies and they all love it very much.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu".

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Super Cool Big Kids Inc.
programme.desc: Convinced old people are the new enemy, Boss Baby uses Tim to create havoc at the senior center, but a war soon begins when the seniors rally against babies

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S3 - Night Creatures
programme.desc: King Julien cant sleep so he decides to go on a milk cleanse to help but after Todd is attacked by a horrible monster King Juliens nightmares cause the kingdom to question him as...THE NIGHT CREATURE

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Mom Genes
programme.desc: When Grug takes Ugga hunting to find her inner growl again, she's as fierce as ever until coming face-to-face with a mom and baby too cute to catch.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Sacrifice at the Edge of Time
programme.desc: The kids are desperate to get back and help their fellow Panda Villagers, and Po decides he must figure out a way to defeat Jindiao before he controls the world

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Boar Games
programme.desc: When Roz the boar comes to San Lorenzo to collect a bounty for capturing Puss, Pajuna tries to keep them separated before an epic fight breaks out

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Birthday Blues
programme.desc: Missing his old life on his birthday, Boss tries to have a full-fledged grown-up celebration in Chicago, but Carol is the only one able to chauffeur and take care of him. The two battle at every stop of the birthday party tour, but when Boss's old work nemesis sets him up for an Federal Investigation Sting at an improv comedy show, Boss and Carol are forced to work together to escape the law.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Crystal Venom
programme.desc: The Castle of Lions mysteriously turns against the Paladins, forcing Princess Allura to make a difficult sacrifice to save Team Voltron.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Collection and Extraction
programme.desc: Team Voltron infiltrates a hidden Galra Space Station to investigate why Zarkon is attacking planets and siphoning the life energy from the universe

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Golden Opportunity
programme.desc: When the PALs find gold, things spiral out of control until Lucky and Spirit have to rescue their friends from the bottom of a mine!

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Elephant Has A Trunk
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Elephant had no nose. He couldn't swat away the flies, or scrub his belly… he couldn't even blow his nose. Then one day snappy Crocodile snapped! Crocodile pulled and he pulled and he pulled… until Ker-doing!!! Crocodile let go and Elephant's nose was all long and wiggly! And that's why Elephant has a trunk. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Snake Has No Legs
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Snake did have legs… hundreds and hundreds of them. But poor old Snake had no eyes, not a single eye on his head. Then on the day of the great Tinga Tinga Festival of Colours Snake quite literally bumped into Millipede who was stuck in a hole. They decided to swap eyes and legs just for one day. So that Snake could see all the wonderful colours and Millipede could run all over Tinga Tinga.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Flash The Marshall
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is going to ban Flash from Silver hatch unless he learns how to do something useful. Can Flash learn how to be a good marshal in time?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hellie's A Winner
programme.desc: Hellie wants to be able to race like the cars. When he does join in he is accused of cheating. Hellie is upset and the cars annoyed… will they be able to make up before something disastrous happens?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dodgems
programme.desc: Marsha decides to be a mechanic but wears Big Chris out with her endless questions. Disaster strikes when Chris dozes off and doesn't listen to her properly…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Tall Story Roary
programme.desc: The loudspeaker system is not working at Silver Hatch. How will Roary be stopped from performing a dangerous stunt on the track?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Car Boot Sale
programme.desc: Big Chris has a clear out and takes all his old junk up to Farmer Green's car boot sale but misses the clutter in Rusty. How will he get everything back?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hot Stuff
programme.desc: Big Chris takes the cars to the beach to relax in the heat but he is so busy dealing with the cars he forgets to drink his water. But hang on, who else has drunk it…

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tacos Rainy Day
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. Kelp’s unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. But it rains and the game is called off until Kelp shows them that playing in the water can be even more fun.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Lair
programme.desc: D-Structs kidnaps Revvit to show the crew who's boss when they compete over construction, so Ty plans the perfect heist to rescue their friend.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Battering Ram
programme.desc: When parts go missing from the garage, Ace and Skya solve the mystery when they discover D-Structs has a new claw-tail which they put to the test.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Harmful Horrors of the Harrowing Hiveschool
programme.desc: After injecting all the teachers with bee DNA, the Melvins run the new "hivemind" of the school. But Ms. Ribble is accidently injected with too much "Bee- NA" and becomes the queen bee, overpowering the Melvins' control. George, Harold and the recently re-hired Vice Principal Krupp must work with the Melvins and stop her from turning everyone into her Zombees.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Chalk The Line Weighting Is The Hardest Part
programme.desc: Eep cheats her way into being considered an adult; Grug learns he's no longer the strongest caveman and turns to a radical method for building brawn

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Wrestlebabia: The Musica Flowers For Munk
programme.desc: When Sandy can't join animal wrestling she poses as "Mandy Monkhuahua"; In order to help Munk, Grug sticks super worms up his nose that make him smarter

programme.desc: With El Circo Dos Grillos in town, memories of Milagro prompt big changes for Lucky and Jim.

In order to stop the satellites, the team engages in an all-out battle against Cleve, Matsuo, and Rafaela.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Sirocco Fire Explosion
programme.desc: Cleve has the team surrounded - is this the end? Suddenly, Cisco bursts in to save the day, along with all of the friends the team has made along the way in the Sahara. Working together, they manage to stop Cleve’s missiles and defeat Rafaela and Matsuo. But before they get a chance to celebrate, a giant fire tornado tears its way through the Sahara destroying everything in its path. Tony decides to make one last daring attempt in order to save the day.
